text:
Ava-CS: Heads-up — StrataLabs flagged high embed spend during onboarding. Their trial account burned through 40% of monthly prepaid in 48h. We need a quick QBR-ready summary + mitigations for tomorrow.

Ravi-CustomerSuccess: Yikes. Do we know which job triggered it?

Sam-FinOps: Early look shows a large nightly bulk embedding job with huge parallelism. Quick query I ran:
```sql
select job_name, sum(tokens) tokens, date_trunc('day', ts) day
from usage
where account='stratalabs' and ts > now() - interval '7 days'
group by 1,3
order by tokens desc
limit 5;
```

ops-bot: Billing alert: account=stratalabs prepaid_usage=42% (threshold 40%). https://billing.internal/accounts/stratalabs

Jordan-AE: Customer says they batch every doc into 1 call to reduce overhead; pilot volume was larger than expected after last import. They want to keep throughput for feature demo Friday.

Ava-CS: Priorities: 1) short-term throttle + concurrency cap 2) 2-scenario forecast for QBR (pilot vs optimized) 3) offer enablement session ASAP 4) consider one-off credit if runway < 10 days.

Sam-FinOps: Quick numbers: 3-day avg=380k tokens/day. Peak run day=1.2M tokens. If they keep peak daily it's an extra ~$5.2k/mo. If we cap concurrency to 25% and recommend 512 batch size -> projected 470k/day. I'll prepare a small table for the deck.

Ravi-CustomerSuccess: Any temporary credit precedents?

Jordan-AE: We have authorized $2k for demo-critical pilots in the past; anything above requires ARR commit or reserved capacity discussion.

Ava-CS: Action list for QBR slide:
- Sam-FinOps: attach table with columns [scenario, avg_daily_tokens, monthly_tokens, est_cost_delta, runway_days]
- Jordan-AE: confirm whether AE can offer $2k demo credit; if not, draft commit proposal
- Ravi-CustomerSuccess: schedule enablement call with StrataLabs (today/tonight?) — aim for tomorrow AM
- Ava-CS: draft slide + recommended throttle policy (api-key level) and links to docs

Sam-FinOps: I'll push the forecast table here by 3pm PT and add a short note on assumptions (token price, rounding).

ops-bot: Suggested policy: rate_limit(api_key=stratalabs_key, max_requests_per_min=60, max_concurrent=6).

Jordan-AE: Customer responded: they can delay the high-volume import until after demo if we give them the demo credit. Asking for $1.5k.

Ravi-CustomerSuccess: Can we pair the credit with a short enablement session to ensure behavior change? I propose a 45m call: batching best practices, caching prefixes, and embed sharding recommendations.

Ava-CS: Yes. We'll make credit contingent on attending enablement + follow-up optimization checklist. Jordan, please confirm credit in CRM and note pilot tag.

Sam-FinOps: Forecast table posted (snippet):
- scenario: "pilot_full" -> daily_tokens 1,200,000 -> monthly_tokens 36,000,000 -> est_monthly_cost +$5,200 -> runway ~18 days
- scenario: "capped_25pct" -> daily_tokens 470,000 -> monthly_tokens 14,100,000 -> est_monthly_cost +$1,900 -> runway ~39 days
(assumes $0.000144/token baseline)

Ravi-CustomerSuccess: Great. I'll book the enablement slot for 9am PT tomorrow and include the optimization checklist.

Ava-CS: I'll build the QBR slide with Sam's table + recommended actions (throttle policy, $1.5k demo credit contingent on enablement, reserved capacity CTA). Will post draft in this thread when ready.

Jordan-AE: Logged $1.5k demo credit in CRM under opportunity #OP-4891 and flagged for finance approval.

ops-bot: Alert rule created: "stratalabs_prepaid >= 90%" -> page: oncall-finops, cs-team.

Sam-FinOps: Approved the quick finance step for the $1.5k credit pending final sign-off. Updated the deck with the two-scenario table.

Ava-CS: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source for QBR action items and spend mitigation steps. Will upload the slide before EOD. :white_check_mark:

(reacts: :rocket: by Jordan-AE)
